title_en: Active-Duty Enlistment Recruitment Schedule for All Armed Forces (December 2026)
summary: The department is sharing the recruitment schedule for active-duty soldiers in each branch of the armed forces, for applications made in December 2026 with enlistment in March 2027. Students who are planning to fulfil their military service obligation should consult the attached schedule for reference. The detailed schedule is only in the attachment, which was not read for this translation.
applies_to: Students, for reference in fulfilling their military service obligation. The notice is for information only and does not state that any action is mandatory.

dates.what: Application period for active-duty soldier recruitment in each branch of the armed forces (exact dates are in the attachment, which was not read)
Enlistment for those who apply in December 2026

conditions: The notice is for reference only and does not itself require any action.
The detailed recruitment schedule for each branch is only in the attached file, which was not read for this translation.
steps: Open and read the attached file '26년 12월 각 군 현역병 모집계획(배부용).hwpx (December 2026 Active-Duty Recruitment Plan for Each Branch, distribution copy) attached to the original notice for the detailed schedule.
translation:
Title: Active-Duty Soldier Recruitment Schedule for Each Branch of the Armed Forces (December 2026)

We are sending, as attached, the recruitment schedule for active-duty soldiers in each branch of the armed forces for those who apply in December 2026 and enlist in March 2027. Please share it so that students may refer to it in fulfilling their military service obligation.

Attachment (1 file):
'26년 12월 각 군 현역병 모집계획(배부용).hwpx (December 2026 Active-Duty Recruitment Plan for Each Branch, distribution copy) (1 MB)

[Note: The content of the attachment was not read and is not included in this translation.]
